working_features: All 7 standard tetromino pieces with distinct colors
Pieces fall automatically from the top at a steady rate
Pieces can be moved left and right with arrow keys
Pieces can be rotated clockwise with the up arrow key
Pieces can be soft-dropped faster with the down arrow key
Pieces lock in place when they land
Completed horizontal rows are detected and cleared
Score display and increase on line clears
Falling speed increases with level
Next piece preview panel
Game ends when new piece cannot be placed
Game over screen shows final score and level
